description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'WorkWeekTest' for the 'WorkWeek' entity in the OrangeHRM project. It tests the functionality of setting and retrieving work week day values, and ensures proper persistence and retrieval of 'WorkWeek' objects within the ORM framework.

classes.name: WorkWeekTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class to verify the functionality of the WorkWeek entity, including setting day lengths, persistence, and retrieval within the ORM context.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating the 'WorkWeek' table before each test.

methods.name: testWorkWeek
methods.description: Creates a WorkWeek instance, sets workday lengths, persists it, and then verifies that the retrieved object has the expected values.
